description: Mortgage refinance analyzer — Should I refinance? Compares the current mortgage with a new one: both payments, monthly savings, simple and TRUE break-even month (counts principal paid down, not just the payment gap), net savings over how long you will stay, lifetime interest, term-extension warning, verdict STRONG REFINANCE / REFINANCE / MARGINAL / DON'T REFINANCE. Required: balance=, rate= (current %), new_rate=. Optional: years_left= or months_left= (default 30y), new_years= (30), closing_costs= (default est. 2.5%), points= (% of loan), roll_costs=true, cash_out=, stay_years=. Offline math. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_refinance
